name: Risheek Nawka
title: Creative technologist
summary: Risheek Nawka is a 19-year-old creative technologist applying to the a16z Horowitz Academy founding class. Tagline: "I build things where art and technology meet." Key facts: Founder, Summer; Consulted for Adobe; 7 creative-tech projects shipped; Gap year, building full-time.
tagline: I build things where art and technology meet.

highlights.title: International karate champion (Seisenkei Shitoryu)
highlights.description: Won gold at the 4th International Karate Championship in 2018, competing in Seisenkei Shitoryu.

highlights.title: Founded Summer, a home décor brand
highlights.description: Started Summer to test whether people would buy home décor the way they buy fashion, with strong brand pull. Close to $16,000 in revenue in under six months from roughly $60 of initial investment. Drew investor attention.

highlights.title: Content that got me a pitch to a top Indian investor
highlights.description: Started creating content on Instagram and LinkedIn. It brought one of India’s biggest investors (a "Shark") to the accelerator, and I pitched to her.

highlights.title: 7 creative-tech projects shipped
highlights.description: Small, free, phone-first creative projects (software and hardware), each shipped publicly with a short reel. New ones are added as they ship.

highlights.title: Consulted for Adobe in San Francisco
highlights.description: Invited to San Francisco for a one-time consulting project for Adobe: go-to-market and competitive analysis for Firefly, and how consumers in India use AI in creative workflows.

projectsNote: Free, phone-first websites for young, expressive people. You do something real with your hands, your phone captures it, the site turns it into something delightful, you send it to someone, and they discover the site.
